facts.statement: Sacred Grove's top chefs compete in a birthday cake contest; the player picks one chef to sponsor, speaking to chefs and then returning to Camellia, with a new chef can be helped each day.
facts.quote: Nous allons faire un petit voyage pour choisir un chef pour parrainer.

article_summaries.title: Guide d'Anniversaire par Arbitre Ruby: Deuxième Partie! (archived as 'Free Realms - What is New?')
article_summaries.summary: Part two of a French-language guide by Arbitre Ruby to the Free Realms first-anniversary celebration. It lists daily quests for the party: helping Camellia with a cake-baking contest, distributing invitations with Papillonnette, collecting balloons from Plumette, gathering food ingredients for Helga, and fighting the Gâtostein (Cakenstein) cake monsters, including ones tied to Glerga and Commandant Kagoul. The page is undated in the capture ('posted 1 year, 1 month ago'), so the exact date is unknown.
